verdict.rationale: LangGraph has explicit built-in support for pausing execution via interrupt() and resuming with a Command carrying human input, backed by checkpointer-based persistence, and this human-in-the-loop capability is documented and reiterated in GitHub's feature list as inspecting/modifying agent state mid-execution. Community commentary corroborates it as a genuine state-machine framework supporting human-in-the-loop with time travel.
